# openwrt_sys_net_routes (Data Source)

Retrieves the IPv4 routing table from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID.
- `routes` (List of Object) List of IPv4 routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `dest` (String)
- `device` (String)
- `flags` (String)
- `gateway` (String)
- `irtt` (Number)
- `metric` (Number)
- `refcount` (Number)
- `usecount` (Number)
